item.title: Pokémon Go 'Into the Wild' 2026 event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go ’s 2026 "Into the Wild" event rolls into this weekend's big Wild Area flagship event, so if you need to do some Max Battles to catch up on building a good party, this is the time. Dynamax Regidrago and Dynamax Meltan will be making their debuts during this, so if you like collecting special Dynamax Pokémon, now's your chance. This event runs from Nov. 9-13 .

item.title: Ridley Scott’s Failed Dune Movie Paved the Way For His Sci-Fi Masterpiece
item.description: Denis Villeneuve’s Dune: Part 3 releases on Dec. 16, completing what has so far been a phenomenal adaptation of Frank Herbert’s seminal space opera. While David Lynch’s surreal 1984 Dune has its defenders, Villeneuve’s version has been far more commercially and critically successful. He’s made some significant deviations from the source material, but overall has proved faithful to its characters and themes while assembling an all-star cast that shines in both dramatic action sequences and smaller scenes of tense intrigue.

item.title: New Physint Details Reveal Major Metal Gear Solid Connection
item.description: "Beyond the Strand" is the 10th-anniversary exhibition celebrating Kojima Productions, the studio founded by video game veteran and Metal Gear Solid creator Hideo Kojima. The exhibition is taking place in Tokyo, but lucky fans are posting pictures online, including some that reveal new details about Kojima's upcoming game, Physint .

item.title: Water Temple dungeon walkthrough in Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Water Temple is a dungeon located at the bottom of Lake Hylia in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, and it's only reachable after Link has traveled into the future.

item.title: Nintendo Officially Teases New Yoshi Lego Set
item.description: Nintendo teased a new Lego set on Monday, and it will star everyone's favorite shoe-wearing dinosaur. On the Nintendo Today app, Nintendo used a close-up image of Lego Yoshi's face to announce the new Yoshi set.

item.title: Honkai: Star Rail version 4.7 release time in your time zone
item.description: Honkai: Star Rail 's 4.7 patch is coming soon, adding the first playable Aeon, Aeon ★ Aha (the artist formerly known as Nihilux). Older characters will also be getting buffs, and the usual slew of events will be taking place, allowing you to earn Stellar Jade and other rewards.

item.title: Sony Officially Announces New Playstation Handheld
item.description: While Sony has largely given up on the handheld market following the death of the now-lamented PlayStation Vita, the company is taking another swing at the PlayStation Portal. Following in Nintendo’s footsteps, Sony will release a Japan-only version of its handheld. The specs are mostly unchanged: the region-locked Portal will have the same 1080p LCD screen and will still be built around remotely accessing a PS5 to play games.

item.title: GTA 6 Preloading Officially Goes Live, Revealing Files That Tease Multiplayer
item.description: With GTA 6 j ust days away, preloading has now begun for players in New Zealand. That means that the game's files are now in the hands of the public, who have wasted no time in scouring over the new information to learn as much as possible about Rockstar's upcoming blockbuster. Even though GTA 6 's files are encrypted, they have revealed some exciting tidbits .

item.title: How Wuthering Waves Drives the Next Evolution of Anime Action RPGs
item.description: Fast combat, fluid traversal and Resonators who fight like themselves: how Wuthering Waves keeps raising the bar for anime action RPGs.

item.title: Mass Effect Creator Is ‘Optimistic’ the Series Will Live On
item.description: BioWare's shutdown has been one of the hardest studio closures in gaming history. The Edmonton-based studio made its way into thousands of gamers' hearts, and it was set to continue this mission with the development of Mass Effect Universe , the next entry in the Mass Effect series. The project may have been canceled, but hope still lingers.
